title: Risky-Bench: Evaluating Agentic Safety Risks in Real-World Life-Assist Deployments
abstract: arXiv:2602.03100v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that operate in real-world environments, introducing safety risks beyond linguistic harm through tool use, external transactions, and multi-step decision making. Existing agent safety evaluations construct risk-oriented tasks that lack a hierarchically organized taxonomy of attack surfaces, rely on predefined harm categories rather than deployment-grounded safety rubrics, and evaluate agent behavior in isolation rather than during realistic, long-horizon task execution. To address these limitations, we propose Risky-Bench, a deployment-grounded framework for systematic agent safety evaluation in life-assist settings. Risky-Bench derives context-aware safety rubrics from domain-agnostic safety principles and systematically probes safety risks across hierarchically organized attack surfaces through realistic task execution under varying threat assumptions. Applied to life

translated_title: Risky-Bench：评估现实世界生活辅助部署中的智能体安全风险
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被部署为在现实世界环境中运行的智能体，通过工具使用、外部交易和多步骤决策，带来了超越语言层面的安全风险。现有的智能体安全评估所构建的面向风险的任务缺乏层级化组织的攻击面分类体系，依赖于预定义的危害类别而非基于部署场景的安全评估标准，并且孤立地评估智能体行为，而非在现实的、长时程任务执行过程中进行评估。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了Risky-Bench，一个面向生活辅助场景、基于真实部署环境的系统性智能体安全评估框架。Risky-Bench从与领域无关的安全原则中推导出情境感知的安全评估标准，并在不同的威胁假设下，通过现实任务执行系统地探测层级化组织的攻击面中的安全风险。应用于生活（辅助场景评估）……
tldr: 提出Risky-Bench，一个基于真实部署场景的生活辅助智能体安全评估框架，通过层级化的攻击面分类和情境感知的安全评估标准，在现实任务执行中系统性探测智能体的安全风险。
en_tdlr: Risky-Bench is a deployment-grounded framework that systematically evaluates agent safety risks in real-world life-assist settings through hierarchically organized attack surfaces and context-aware safety rubrics during realistic task execution.
